representation.transform: identity; exact full original-bound UTF-16 span text
representation.document_vectors: reuse original verified span-only vectors; no document re-embedding
representation.overlength: reject; no truncation, merging or new windows

preprocessing.lexical: existing terms(): unique lowercase ASCII alphanumeric terms, length>2, same existing stop list; evidence text only
preprocessing.semantic: unchanged verified BERT WordPiece encoder, CLS/SEP, maximum256tokens, masks, mean pooling and L2 normalization
preprocessing.query_guard: same existing validQuery() for both methods

ranking.lexical: one point per distinct query term present in span text
ranking.semantic: cosine dot product of normalized384-dimensional vectors
ranking.cutoff_note: raw top-k diagnostic for both methods; zero/negative scores may appear and are not support. Original asymmetric thresholds were lexical3/semantic0, so historical comparison is not a single-variable ablation.
ranking.tie_break: ascending existing window ID using en locale
ranking.unit_deduplication: highest-scoring window per unit before top-k

evaluation.recall: macro average over unchanged positive provisional expected-unit sets; unsupported cases excluded
evaluation.comparison: original saved asymmetric rows, same40seen questions; no original rerun
evaluation.historical_cohorts: may describe old24/16cohorts, explicitly both now seen; no fresh holdout claim

resources.storage_policy: Choice B expressly approved for N14-03 only; transient overshoot risk acknowledged
